k14ft7lr543qp7uo4i75dsqiac.summary: Your recent alignment conversations with Adam and Jon highlight critical capacity deficits across the data architecture—specifically the P&C loss model crisis on Snowflake and the operational drag from the complex operating model. The transition of data design responsibilities has created significant friction and anxiety—making Chris's potential involvement critical to stabilizing the team structure and closing the execution gaps. You need to leverage this sync to address these capacity constraints—and ensure you check in on how Chris is doing personally.
tasks: Ask Chris how he is doing and check on his overall transition and well-being.
Outline the critical capacity deficits—specifically the Snowflake migration bottlenecks and the operational drag of the current seven-to-eight step handoff model.
Propose Chris's alignment to oversee the newly transitioned five-person data design team and buffer the friction with shadow architecture groups.
Secure commitment on Resource Capacity planning to support the P&C architecture milestones.
k14ft7lr543qp7uo4i75dsqiac.title: Sync with Chris

lmh2ct5m46k02f92il48ebp380.summary: You must prepare for critical shifts coming from your recent leadership sessions—most notably the upcoming August 4th architectural reorganization and headcount reduction. Recent alignment with RV and Arden establishes a harder line on architecture governance—introducing strict permit-to-design tollgates and capability-based mapping—while redefining your engagement model with TVO. Tooling directives provide clear start/stop/continue boundaries—specifically stopping forced Jira Work Management and OurDoc compliance in favor of fit-for-purpose utility.
tasks: Finalize preparation for the August 4th architectural staffing changes—targeting a ten percent reduction—by reviewing the finalized stack-ranked list with HR.
Establish explicit measurement criteria for Non-Functional Requirements to satisfy gaps identified during the Arden governance alignment session.
Decommission the mandatory usage of Jira Work Management and OurDoc for personal task tracking—shifting instead to fit-for-purpose tooling.
Pivot the technology roadmap from domain-level strategies toward capability-based mapping to align with RV's platform strategy.
lmh2ct5m46k02f92il48ebp380.title: Weekly Staff – P&C CTO Leadership (series ends 1/7/27)
